## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Every new figure has a source, or a `TODO(...)` marker saying what evidence would close it
- [ ] Anything appearing in more than one place lives in `data/`, not in a hand-written table
- [ ] No em dashes, no emoji in content, and the name is never shortened to "Apogee"
- [ ] If I edited `data/system.yaml`, I ran `make schematic` and committed the result
- [ ] If I edited `hardware/oapogee.tsx`, I ran `make hw` and committed the result
